{"path":"todo_anthropic-claude-sonnet-5_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete, self-contained Todo app as a single HTML file named todo_anthropic-claude-sonnet-5_01.html. Include inline <style> CSS and inline <script> JS (no external dependencies).

Requirements:
- Clean, modern, centered card UI with a title "Todo App", an input field with placeholder "What needs to be done?" and an "Add" button to add new todos (also support pressing Enter to add).
- Each todo item shows: a checkbox to toggle complete/incomplete (completed todos get strikethrough text and a muted/faded color), the todo text, and a delete button (e.g. an "×" or trash icon) to remove it.
- Filter tabs/buttons: "All", "Active", "Completed" that filter the visible list; highlight the currently active filter button.
- A footer/status area showing count of remaining active (not completed) todos, e.g. "3 items left".
- A "Clear completed" button that removes all completed todos.
- Persist todos (text, completed state, id) to localStorage on every change (add/toggle/delete/clear), and load them from localStorage on page load so state survives refresh.
- Handle empty state gracefully (e.g. show "No todos yet" or similar when list is empty for current filter).
- All CSS in a <style> tag in <head>, all JS in a <script> tag before </body>, using vanilla JavaScript (no frameworks/libraries). Use semantic HTML5. Make it visually polished with a pleasant color scheme, rounded corners, subtle shadows, good spacing, and responsive (works well on mobile widths too).
- Escape/sanitize todo text when rendering to avoid HTML injection (use textContent or proper escaping, not raw innerHTML insertion of user input)."}
